Note: The Museum is open Wed-Mon (Closed Tuesday) from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Tickets are valid only for the selected date, and guests arriving after 3:00 PM should expect a shorter visit. The Memorial Courtyard and Japanese Garden of Peace are free and open daily until 5:00 PM. We strongly recommend that you purchase tickets online.
